cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: You Could at Least…
cards.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved a review of my evening. These circles are the buses I missed waiting for you to return my keys.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we put it away? It was twenty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Closure is not approved. Three buses, and this receipt dates the dinner that went cold. You may inspect both.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll buy another dinner. Can we clear the table?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Compensation is declined. An apology will secure immediate clearance. Say you're sorry and I'll retire the entire exhibition.

reason: Make A preside over visible evidence and rule on B repair offer, keeping apology rather than money the simplest route to clearing the complaint.
